step1_figure.circuit_type: Two-stage Folded-Cascode Operational Amplifier with Indirect (Cascode) Compensation and Class-AB Output Stage
step1_figure.description: The circuit implements a high-speed, high-gain operational amplifier utilizing a PMOS folded-cascode first stage driving a push-pull/class-AB output stage. Compensation is achieved via indirect feedback compensation (Ahuja/cascode compensation) using capacitor C0 connected to internal low-impedance nodes, eliminating the right-half-plane (RHP) zero and significantly extending unity-gain bandwidth.

open_loop_gain.description: Low-frequency small-signal open-loop differential voltage gain

equation.explanation: Overall DC gain is the product of the first-stage transconductance, first-stage cascode output impedance, and second-stage gain.
equation.assumptions: First stage is folded cascode with cascoded PMOS/NMOS loads; second stage is common-source output.

sky130_expected.calculation: With I_tail = 94 uA (I_D1 = 47 uA), W/L = 11*1u/0.15u ~ 73.3, g_m1 = sqrt(2 * up*Cox * (W/L) * I_D) = sqrt(2 * 50e-6 * 73.3 * 47e-6) = 587 uS. Cascode output impedance R_out1 ~ (g_m_casc * r_o^2) / 2 ~ 1.5 Mohm. First-stage gain A_v1 ~ 587 uS * 1.5 Mohm ~ 880 (58.9 dB). Output stage gain A_v2 ~ g_m_out * (r_on || r_op || R_L) ~ 15-25 dB with RLOAD=25k. Total A_v0 ~ 75-85 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: High-gain folded-cascode first stage combined with an output stage provides typical gains near 75-80 dB into a 25 kOhm load.

unity_gain_frequency.description: Gain-bandwidth product / frequency where open-loop gain crosses 0 dB

equation.explanation: With indirect compensation, the feedback current from the output is fed into a low-impedance internal node, setting the effective compensation bandwidth based on input pair gm and indirect capacitor C0.
equation.assumptions: C_c = C0 = 1.3 pF; non-dominant poles reside above unity-gain frequency.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Indirect compensation avoids the RHP zero associated with standard Miller compensation, enabling high GBW around 50-75 MHz.

phase_margin.description: Phase of the open-loop gain when magnitude crosses 0 dB plus 180 degrees

equation.explanation: Phase margin evaluates closed-loop stability under unity-gain feedback.
equation.assumptions: Dominant pole at f_p1, second pole set by load capacitance (15 nF is extremely heavy, requiring proper damping network).

sky130_expected.calculation: Due to the large external capacitive load CLOAD = 15 nF and indirect network (C1=45pF, R0=40k), secondary poles are shaped to maintain stable operation with PM > 50 degrees.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Designed for stable operation with high phase margin across process corners.

slew_rate.description: Maximum rate of change of output voltage under large-signal step conditions

equation.explanation: Slew rate is limited by charging/discharging the compensation capacitor with the tail current.

sky130_expected.calculation: SR = 94 uA / 1.3 pF = 72.3 V/us. Under heavy load CLOAD = 15 nF, output current slew rate may be dominated by output branch current: I_out_max / CLOAD.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Internal slew rate is ~72 V/us, while output charging into a large 15 nF capacitor limits external slew rate depending on maximum push-pull output current.

output_swing.description: Peak-to-peak output voltage range with linear operation

equation.explanation: Output swing is set by the overdrive voltages of the common-source output stage transistors xm11 and xm23.
equation.assumptions: V_ov,n ~ 0.15 V, V_ov,p ~ 0.15 V, VDD = 1.8 V.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Push-pull output allows wide rail-to-rail output swing, constrained only by drain-source saturation voltages.

input_common_mode_range.description: Allowable input common-mode voltage range where input PMOS remain saturated

equation.formula: V_ICMR,min = V_tail - |Vth,p| - V_ov,p; V_ICMR,max = VDD - V_ov,tail - |Vth,p|
equation.explanation: For PMOS input pair, upper limit is VDD - V_ov,tail - |Vth,p| and lower limit is governed by the drain potential keeping inputs saturated.

sky130_expected.reasoning: PMOS differential input pair supports common-mode voltages extending near the negative rail.

power_dissipation.description: Total static DC power consumption of the amplifier

equation.explanation: Sum of bias generation, first stage, second stage, and output quiescent branch currents multiplied by 1.8 V.
equation.assumptions: VDD = 1.8 V, nominal bias current source I0 = 47 uA.

sky130_expected.calculation: Total quiescent current across bias chains, diff pair, and output stage is approximately 300 uA to 600 uA. P = 1.8 V * 450 uA = 8.1e-4 W = 0.81 mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Multiple mirrored bias branches of 47 uA plus folded cascode and output stage bias lead to < 1 mW power consumption.

* SECOND STAGE

xm68 NET1 VB4 GNDA GNDA sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm68} w={W_xm68} m=50

* OUTPUT STAGE
xm23 VOUT NET10 GNDA GNDA sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm23} w={W_xm23} m=11
xm11 VOUT VOUTP VDDA VDDA sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11} m=9

* COMPENSATION (Indirect Amplifier)
C0 VOUTP VOUT 1.3e-12
C1 NET10 NET4 45e-12
R0 NET4 GNDA 40e3

* BIAS CURRENT SOURCE
I0 VB1 GNDA 47e-6
.ends IAC

* Power Supplies
VDD VDD 0 DC 1.8
VSS VSS 0 DC 0

* DUT Instantiation
XDUT VSS VDD VINN VINP VOUT IAC

* Output Load
CLOAD VOUT 0 15e-9
RLOAD VOUT 0 25e3

* Input DC Biasing & AC Stimulus
* Differential AC using large inductor feedback for closed-loop DC / open-loop AC (Middlebrook loop)
VCM VINP 0 DC 0.9 AC 1
L_FB VOUT VINN 1000
C_FB VINN 0 1000

.control
* 1. DC Operating Point & Power Dissipation
op
let p_diss = -i(VDD) * 1.8
print p_diss

* 2. AC Analysis (Open-Loop Gain, Bandwidth, Phase Margin)
ac dec 100 1 100MEG
let aol_db = vdb(VOUT)
let phase_deg = 180/PI * cph(v(VOUT))

meas ac dc_gain find aol_db at=10
meas ac ugbw when aol_db=0 fall=1
meas ac pm_deg find phase_deg when aol_db=0 fall=1

* 3. DC Sweep for Output Voltage Swing
alter L_FB 0
alter C_FB 1p
* Break feedback for DC transfer
alter input VCM dc=0.9
dc VCM 0.0 1.8 0.01
meas dc vout_max max v(VOUT)
meas dc vout_min min v(VOUT)

* 4. Transient Analysis for Slew Rate
alter VCM dc=0.9
VSTEP VINP 0 PULSE(0.4 1.4 100n 1n 1n 1u 2u)
tran 1n 2u
meas tran v_max max v(VOUT)
meas tran v_min min v(VOUT)
meas tran sr_rise trig v(VOUT) val=0.6 rise=1 targ v(VOUT) val=1.2 rise=1
let sr = (1.2 - 0.6) / (sr_rise * 1e-6)
print sr

quit
.endc
.end
